 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order

At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner was granted provision bail by Co- ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 26.03.2025 with a condition that petitioner shall surrender in the Court below for a period of 4 weeks from the date of that order and submit a surrender certificate before this Court.

2. By filing supplementary affidavit, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that pursuant to the order passed by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court and in compliance of the same , petitioner has already surrendered on 23.04.2025 before the Court below .

3 . Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .
4.

The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections Section 409, 420, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.86421 of 2024(4) dt.09-05-2025 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code .

5 . As per the prosecution case , informant, namely alleged that this petitioner along with co-accused Md. Iltaf Hussain purchased 1299.40 MT of paddy during the kharif marketing season 2023-24 out of which 883.592 MT of paddy was to be supplied to the Bihar State Food Corporation, however,
only 290 MT paddy was supplied and upon physical verification, the warehouse was found empty indicating embezzlement of 893.8 MT of government paddy worth Rs. 1,97,35,104/-.

It is further alleged that the accused persons, including this petitioner, misreported stocks, falsified records and Pradeep Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6701114/
1 also obstructed verification .
6. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that petitioner is quite innocent and has not committed any offence as alleged.

He further submits that co- accused Rakesh Kumar Singh who was Chairman of the PACS has already granted anticipatory bail vide order dated 17.04.2025 passed in Cr. Misc No. 11006 of 2025 with a direction to deposit the disputed defalcated amount through demand draft in favour of District Manager, Bihar State Food Patna High Court CR.

Petitioner claims clean antecedent.
Charge sheet has already been submitted.
Petitioner is in custody since 30.08.2024 .
7. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

8 . Considering the fact that co-accused Rakesh Kumar Singh who was Chairman of the PACS has already granted anticipatory bail, clean antecedent, period of custody and other circumstances of the case , prayer for regular bail of the petitioner is allowed.

Let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned ACJM - IV Aurangabad in connection with Feshar P.
S. Case No. 84 of 2024 .
